text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d the t-r-u-s-t b-u-i-l-d i-n-f-o r-e-c-o-r-d-s in the s-c-h-e-m-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t and left b-e-h-i-n-d a p-e-r-s-o-n-a f-i-l-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the a-c-t-o-r t-r-a-n-s-m-i-t-t-e-d the m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e r-e-c-r-u-i-t m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s to the t-a-r-g-e-t g-r-o-u-p and left b-e-h-i-n-d a l-o-g o-f s-e-n-d-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-s-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t.
3) the a-c-t-o-r e-n-a-b-l-e-d the a-n-t-i-r-e-p-o-r-t t-e-c-h-n-i-q-u-e and left b-e-h-i-n-d a d-a-t-a b-a-s-e o-f t-a-r-g-e-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-e-g-a-l c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) the a-c-t-o-r p-r-o-c-e-s-s-e-d the e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y m-e-n-t r-e-q-u-e-s-t and left b-e-h-i-n-d a t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n r-e-c-e-i-p-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
5) the a-c-t-o-r c-l-o-s-e-d the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e l-o-g and left b-e-h-i-n-d a s-u-m-m-a-r-y r-e-p-o-r-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t f-i-l-i-n-g.
